286.title: 051 YOUNG MONEY
286.notes: Originally a Gangster Disciples set in the 2000s; in that era they formed one of the most powerful alliances in South Chicago with MetBoyz.

7494.title: 051 YOUNG MONEY
7494.notes: Originally a Gangster Disciples set in the 2000s.

7893.title: 400E MURDA DRIVE
7893.notes: Rapper L'A Capone of the 600 was very close to this set and its members, including JB Bin Laden. They represent the "L'A Gang" for the killed L'A Capone of the 600, and the "Pluto Gang" for a killed Lamron member.

290.title: 50 STRONG
290.notes: A few years ago they expanded their territory by taking two blocks from FollyBoyz.

7909.title: 5TH WARD
7909.notes: They represent "Quint City" and "Gudda World" in tribute to deceased THF 46 members. Rapper Lil Jay is originally from this set.

1767.title: 5TH WARD LIFE
1767.notes: Engaged in a long-running war against these enemies.

227.notes: Founded by D-Thang and Lil Boo with help from Baldy, in mid-2010; Lamron had to validate their integration into the 300 alliance.

344.title: 800 YOUNG MONEY
344.notes: Created after the death of Diddy Grove of CrankTown.

7890.title: 800 YOUNG MONEY
7890.notes: Formed as an offshoot of CrankTown after the death of Diddy Grove; only the Mickey Cobra OGs who belong to both 051 and 800 are still connected.

7910.title: 8TRE MOBB
7910.notes: Producer and rapper Young Chop is originally from this set.

7912.title: ABK
7912.notes: ABK stands for "Anybody Killer". Around 2010-2011, seeking glory, ABK turned on BlackMobb and allied with NLMB.

7914.title: BASHVILLE
7914.notes: Rapper KuGlo is a member of this set.

7892.title: BLACKGATE
7892.notes: Part of the "300" movement. Rapper "SD" is a member of this set.

283.title: BLACKMOBB
283.notes: Formerly allied with ABK until ABK turned against them and allied with NLMB instead.

7492.title: BLACKMOBB
7492.notes: Formerly allied with ABK until ABK turned against them and allied with NLMB instead.

6277.title: BRICK CITY/600
6277.notes: Created mid-2010; formerly known as "Brick City", which was originally a Gangster and Black Disciples set before becoming Black Disciples only. The alliance with NLMB applies only to part of the 600's membership.

7496.title: BRICK$QUAD 069
7496.notes: Founded by Killa Kellz, a former OG of Lamron. War with Dipset broke out after Dipset killed Aiki.

7982.title: BRICKYARD (4 CORNER GLO GANG)
7982.notes: Known for their affiliation with Glo Gang. In 2017, several high-ranking members were arrested under a federal RICO investigation.

7964.title: BUFF CITY
7964.notes: Located in the Wild 100's. Rapper "Joc Da Block" is a member. Many current members formerly belonged to WIIIC City (now O'Block); some were close to Odee of WIIIC City. In 2019 a member close to Deathrow 085 killed an NLMB member.

7997.title: BWst LATIN KINGS
7997.notes: Located in the North Pole area of Chicago.

6535.title: CHRIS WORLD
6535.notes: Based in Washington Park; founded in tribute to Chris of TYMB after his death. Chris World gradually became a fully independent set and went to war with its origin set, TYMB.

7915.title: CRANKTOWN
7915.notes: Almost no one represents this set today; most members became members of the "800" after Diddy's death.

7988.title: CUTTAGANG
7988.notes: A set dating back to the 1980s.

7904.title: DEATHROW 085
7904.notes: Some members were once allied with GMEBE until GMEBE's Roe was killed; the war with the Latin Dragons goes back more than 15 years.

7935.title: DELL MOB
7935.notes: Based in Bronzeville/Oakland; represents 'OJ World' in tribute to deceased Jaro City member OJ.

7999.title: DIPSET BLVD
7999.notes: A faction of OTE based in Cabrini Green; killed PBG member Dutty in 2019 at a shared party, after which OTE and several PBG allies turned against them.

6278.title: DIPSET/FRONT$TREET
6278.notes: Producer DJ Kenn and rapper Chief Keef, who represents them, are from this set; was a drug fortress in the 2000s and remains a major dealer set despite the towers being demolished.

6537.title: DOGGPOUND
6537.notes: Based in Englewood; rapper Lil Durk, his brother D-Thang, and their cousin OTF Nuski are from this set; part of the '300' movement.

7971.title: DRO CITY
7971.notes: A neighborhood made up of several Gangster Disciples sets (SnoBlock, now TPG; DBlock; RowLife; SawBlock; Roc Creek; Hood Gang); formerly called MurderTown and Ghost Town, and before that Eastside Disciples, renamed after Dro's death in 2005; part of OTF's original lineup; their rap group is MuBu (Man Up Band Up).

7919.title: E-BLOCK
7919.notes: Tooka and Wooski of STL/EBT originate from this set.

7907.title: FACEWORLD
7907.notes: Based in Marquette Park; rapper OTF Nuski was a member of this set.

7926.title: GEO DRIVE
7926.notes: Based in Washington Park; rapper Jusblow of the 600 originates from this set.

944.title: GGE
944.notes: Wages an internal war against other sets within the MoeTown alliance.

7965.title: GOONIE GANG
7965.notes: Subject of one of the largest investigations in recent years in Chicago, in 2018.

8002.title: GUTTAVILLE
8002.notes: A very old set; renamed LexVille after the death of Lex.

7955.title: GUTTAVILLE GANGSTAS (GVG)
7955.notes: Based in Edgewater; the DayDay World nickname honors deceased member DayDay.

7994.title: GUWOPGANG 075
7994.notes: Repeatedly shouted out by Lil Herb (G Herbo); ShootaShellz has clashed with them over their ties to the NLMB.

7099.title: HARVEY WORLD
7099.notes: Located in Harvey, a small suburb south of Chicago; in 2012 clashed with Chief Keef over a perceived diss against a deceased member, leading to ongoing clashes with O'Block.

7947.title: HELLA BANDZ
7947.notes: Located in West Pullman; rapper Lil Mouse was a member.

7956.title: HOOLA GANG
7956.notes: Based in Uptown; formerly merged with PBG/TFG until they killed TFG's King Shoota, since then at war.

7923.title: INSANE MONEY MOB (IMM)
7923.notes: IMM stands for Insane Money Mob.

243.title: JARO CITY
243.notes: Formerly known as ABM/COB before Jaro was killed.

7486.title: JARO CITY
7486.notes: Formerly known as ABM/COB before Jaro was killed; known as a set of dealers and money-makers rather than shooters despite common perception; the reason the 600 was created.

7998.title: KEDIZE HOMICIDE KINGS
7998.notes: Located at North Pole; at war with other Latin Kings sets, notably RCst (Rosemont & Claremont).

7491.title: KILL TO SURVIVE (KTS)
7491.notes: KTS is an alliance of sets including Lakeside GDs, PocketTown, and 075 Vice Lords, that itself became a set members represent.

7894.title: KILLAWARD 078
7894.notes: Killaward is represented by several mutually warring sets including New Money and 75th; one of the first Gangster Disciples sets to feud internally; rappers King Von, Lil $hawn, King Samson, and Loskiii are from this set; formerly called 'Ward', renamed 'KillaWard' in honor of Killa (aka Lil Will), killed in the BBG Terror Dome neighborhood.

7489.title: LAMRON
7489.notes: A very old set, now money-focused; rappers Lil Durk and Lil Reese represent Lamron; part of the '300' movement; shot at the funeral of James from M-Town.

8007.title: LEXIQUE
8007.notes: This is a glossary entry defining the term BACKDOOR (luring an ally or enemy through a door to kill them), popularized in Chicago after the death of Melly 051, not a set biography.

7957.title: LIL4MOBB
7957.notes: Based in Uptown; renamed after Lil 4 was killed; known for killing rapper Young Pappy.

7954.title: LOC CITY
7954.notes: LOC stands for Loyalty Over Cash; based in Rogers Park.

450.title: LOC CITY (BotY)
450.notes: Not to be confused with the LOC City in North Chicago.

7991.title: LOC CITY (BotY)
7991.notes: Not to be confused with the LOC City from North Pole; mostly BDK.

1790.title: LORDSVILLE
1790.notes: Long-running war against DamenVille, LOC City and W.B 057.

7944.title: LOWELIFE
7944.notes: Based in Englewood; part of the '300' movement; went to war with former ally AMG in 2017.

7936.title: MET BOYZ
7936.notes: Based in Washington Park; formed in the 2000s as '051 Met Boyz' from the merger of Met Boyz and 051, once the most powerful alliance in South Chicago.

7938.title: MITCH BLOCK
7938.notes: Based in the Wild 100's; fell out with STL/EBT and rapper Lil Jay after an extortion attempt, which led to Lil Jay and FBG Butta's imprisonment.

8005.title: MNA (4CH)
8005.notes: Based in West Chicago; responsible for a triple murder outside a store in late 2019.

7483.title: MOB
7483.notes: MOB stands for Mind On Business.

7490.title: MOETOWN
7490.notes: MoeTown is an alliance made up of Folly Boyz, GGE, Lowelife (not the separate set of the same name), Murdafield, D-Block, BackBlock, SODMG, Just-Us, OTL, 5400, KTC, Jet Black, AMB, MackTown and Jackboys.

7963.title: MONEY BY ANY MEANS (MBAM)
7963.notes: Based in the Wild 100's; rapper Lil Flip is a member.

7953.title: MTG
7953.notes: Named 'Drama World' in honor of slain member Drama; known for killing Capo of the GBE; some NLMB members still represent Drama World.

7906.title: MTV
7906.notes: Based in Chatham; rapper Tray Savage of Glo Gang is a member.

7933.title: MURDATOWN
7933.notes: Responsible for the imprisonment of RondoNumba9 and Cdai of the 600, though relations with the 600 remain good; at war with MOB since 2020.

1152.title: MURDERVILLE
1152.notes: MurderVille was the former name of the set now known as STL/EBT; nobody uses the MurderVille name anymore.

7925.title: NICKO GANG
7925.notes: Based in Washington Park; considered the future generation of the 600.

7937.title: NO LIMIT 087
7937.notes: Formerly at war with NLMB; tensions have cooled and relations became neutral.

7487.title: NO LIMIT/MUSKEGON BOYZ
7487.notes: NLMB stands for Never Leave My Brothers, an alliance of No Limit (Renegade Black P.Stones) and Muskegon Boys (Renegade Gangster Disciples), an EBK set; rappers G Herbo and Lil Bibby are members; still represents MTG's slain member's Drama World despite now being at war with MTG.

8000.title: NOSEDMOBB
8000.notes: Based in the Holy City area; named in honor of a member who died in 2009.

7895.title: OAK BOYZ NATION (OBN)
7895.notes: OBN stands for Oak Boyz Nation; source bio text is truncated (cuts off mid-sentence).

7960.title: ONLY THE END (OTE)
7960.notes: Based in Near North Side; some OTE members also represent PBG.

7949.title: OUT7AW CITY
7949.notes: Rapper No Good Loso is a member.

1151.title: O’BLOCK
1151.notes: Renamed from WIIIC City in honor of member Odee after his death; considered a stronghold for Black Disciples and their allies.

8006.title: P-BLOCK (4CH)
8006.notes: Based in West Chicago; rapper Lil Savage is a member.

7943.title: PAXTOWN
7943.notes: Based in South Shore; co-founded by the father of TB from Tyquan World.

7488.title: PBG/TFG
7488.notes: PBG (Rogers Park) was called Insane Cutthroat Gangsters before Pooh Bear was killed and stands for Pooh Bear Gang; TFG (Uptown) stands for The Fucking Guys.

7930.title: POCKETTOWN
7930.notes: Considered a legendary set for having bodies on random sets.

7946.title: RISKY ROAD
7946.notes: Big Swirl, brother of RondoNumba9 from the 600, is a member of this set.

7897.title: SEDVILLE
7897.notes: Located in the Near North Side; rapper Polo G is a member.

7899.title: SHAWN MONEY BOYZ (SMB)
7899.notes: Part of the '300' movement; known for killing rapper Lil Jojo of Brick$quad 069 in 2012.

7931.title: SKEEZE WORLD
7931.notes: Rappers King Yella and Drake of Chiraq are members; based in West Englewood.

7928.title: SOUTH KING DRIVE (SKD)
7928.notes: SKD is short for South King Drive.

7898.title: SQUIRTTOWN
7898.notes: No longer active; today the set exists only to honor its deceased members.

7484.title: STL/EBT
7484.notes: STL (Saint Lawrence) and EBT (Eberhart) merged into one set, based in Woodlawn.

7962.title: SUWU MOBB
7962.notes: Located in the Near North Side.

7900.title: SUWU TTB
7900.notes: Based in Bronzeville/Oakland; the enmity with the 757 is recent.

7961.title: TAETOWN
7961.notes: Based in Evanston; formerly called 'South End' before Tae died.

7901.title: TAY CITY
7901.notes: Based in Englewood; was friendly with the 600 through Duke Da Beast and S.Dot's closeness, but turned hostile (became BDK) after Lil Jojo's death.

7995.title: TEDAMOBB
7995.notes: Rappers Lil Randy and Prince Glo are members.

7902.title: THF 44
7902.notes: D.Rose of the 600 has referenced (dissed) them in a song before.

7493.title: THF 46
7493.notes: THF 46 stands for Trigga Happy Family; based in Woodlawn.

7495.title: TYMB
7495.notes: Based in Woodlawn; many members claim 'EBK'; formerly ran a shooter crew together with Lamron; some members associate with the 051 Young Money and allies, others with O'Block.

7485.title: TYQUAN WORLD
7485.notes: Most members come from Jaro City or STL/EBT; the set was formed after the death of 'Tyquan' from Jaro City.

7993.title: TYTOLAND
7993.notes: Based in the Back of the Yards.

7990.title: VON WORLD
7990.notes: Formerly called 'Bully Gang'; renamed after Von's death.

874.title: W.B
874.notes: W.B stands for Winchester Wolcott Boyz.

6528.title: WELCH WORLD
6528.notes: Formerly called 'So Icy' until Welch was killed; a very old set that produced well-known people such as Tay600, Billionaire Black and his brother Richie Jerk.

7941.title: WHIZ CITY
7941.notes: Full name Whiz City BrainDead; based in Chatham.

240.title: WIIIC CITY
240.notes: Formerly called 'BlockHeads' in the 1990s, then W(ild) I(nsane) IIC(razy) City; today known as O'Block, and in the early 2000s shared its neighborhood with No Luv City.

6273.title: WIIIC CITY/O’BLOCK
6273.notes: Formerly known as WIIIC City before member Odee was killed; the new generation represents 'Jmacc Block' for slain member Jmacc of MetLife; was once at war with Brick City (predecessor of the 600) though the two never killed each other.

7951.title: WUGA WORLD
7951.notes: Based in Englewood; rappers Rico Recklezz and Lil Mister are members; in early 2020 they assaulted TTE/OTF member DeDe.

627.title: ZOLAND
627.notes: Also known as ABM; formerly called 'Chestnut'; mostly 4 Corner Hustlers with a minority of Gangster Disciples and Black P.Stones members.
